 "data": "classDiagram
 class StorageService {
 <<interface>>
 +upload(MultipartFile, String folder) String
 +delete(String key)
 +getKey(String fileUrl) String
 +getFileUrl(String key) String
 }
 class LocalStorageService {
 -LocalStorageConfig config
 -StorageFileValidator validator
 +upload(MultipartFile, folder) String
 }
 class S3StorageService {
 -AwsProperties awsProperties
 -S3Client s3Client
 -StorageFileValidator validator
 +upload(MultipartFile, folder) String
 }
 class StorageFileValidator {
 +validate(MultipartFile)
 }
 class AwsProperties {
 <<config record>>
 +region String
 +bucketName String
 +endpoint String
 }
 class LocalStorageConfig {
 <<config>>
 }
 class S3Config {
 +s3Client() S3Client
 }

 StorageService <|.. LocalStorageService : \"local\" qualifier
 StorageService <|.. S3StorageService : \"s3StorageService\" qualifier
 LocalStorageService --> StorageFileValidator
 S3StorageService --> StorageFileValidator
 S3StorageService --> AwsProperties
 S3Config --> S3StorageService : provides S3Client bean
 LocalStorageConfig --> LocalStorageService",
 "config": null
